spell:bloodwave.maxBonus: health the caster gained in the current battle

spell:bone-spear.maxBonus: health, all other enemies take a moderate amount of damage as well

spell:clayman.maxBonus: health equal to its Current health

spell:engorge.maxBonus: health and loses a massive amount of defense and speed

spell:flesh-offering.maxBonus: health, and your creatures gain 20% of that amount

spell:fragmenting-arrow.maxBonus: health, all other enemies take this damage as well

spell:heat-wave.maxBonus: health is reduced by the amount of damage dealt

spell:hypertrophy.maxBonus: health equal to 35% of its other stats

spell:laser-beam.maxBonus: health equal to 100% of the damage dealt

spell:morph-life.maxBonus: health and their classes become Life until the end of battle

spell:vitality-explosion.maxBonus: health it has greater than its base amount
